sources.full: Chaos at the Food Court: Modern Earth

adventure.name: Chaos at the Food Court: Modern Earth
adventure.author: Offscreen Worlds, adapted from the 2019 C2E2 premise

entries.name: Session at a Glance
entries: Four level-8 adventurers arrive from Thornwatch through a cinema screen. Bombeldo's antique projector opened nine secondary rifts, scattering monsters through a modern mall. Nine living planar links hold the projector's crystal open. Each link ends when its monster dies, leaves the building, or travels off-plane. The dragon has claimed Coronet Jewelers; Eddie Vale's attempted robbery brings it into the food court.

entries.caption: Encounter budget: four level-8 PCs; low 4,000 / moderate 6,800 / high 8,400 XP
rows: 1 Bulette, 2 Displacer Beasts, 1 Gelatinous Cube, 1 Spectator

entries.name: What Happened
entries: Bombeldo Trask, proprietor of The Dungeoneer, bought an antique crystal projector at an estate sale. His tests resonated with a weak point near the Thornwatch arch, causing violet lights, hums, and strange reflections. He brought it to the West cinema for a promotional screening.

When Bombeldo switched on the projector, its beam struck the movie screen and connected to the Thornwatch arch. The adventurers crossed through that primary doorway. The overload opened secondary rifts and released one Hydra, one Bulette, two Displacer Beasts, one Gelatinous Cube, one Spectator, two Owlbears, and one Young Red Dragon. All nine entered before the party reached the mall concourse.

Each creature from a secondary rift carries a living planar link while inside the mall's exterior walls or on its roof. Death, travel to another plane, or moving beyond the exterior walls breaks the link; leaving the building doesn't kill or banish the creature. An unconscious creature still maintains its link. The PCs crossed through the primary screen, so they carry no link.

The projector has nine visible violet strands within its crystal, one per creature. Each strand darkens when its link breaks. Turning the crystal or moving with it reveals the general direction of the remaining links as their light and sound intensify. DC 13 Intelligence (Arcana) identifies the resonant feedback; observing the strands requires no check.

The red STOP lever shuts off the projector's electrical motor, but the crystal continues projecting while any link remains. Once all links are broken, STOP produces a stable cinema-screen doorway to Thornwatch for 60 seconds. If STOP was already selected, the doorway opens when the final link breaks. An intact machine can be cycled again after the window closes. A shattered crystal cannot produce the controlled doorway.

The dragon settled in Coronet Jewelers among necklaces, watches, stones, and gold. It guards the store as its hoard. It has no allegiance to other escaped monsters. Two Owlbears forage in separate food-service rooms; the food-court creatures occupy nearby dining areas.

After the food-court disturbance, Eddie Vale notices Coronet's broken glass and tries to steal a velvet tray of jewelry. The dragon pursues the stolen treasure into the food court if Eddie succeeds. Intercepting Eddie changes what happens; the dragon remains in the store unless its territory or valuables are threatened.

entries.name: Table Coordinates and Pieces
entries: WEST FOLDING MAT: 22×26 squares. Cinema, booth C3–E4, security office P3–U9, Hydra fountain I12–O18. EAST ROLLED MAT: 34×22 squares. Food court, kitchens and Coronet Jewelers X2–AG8. Both maps use 5-foot squares, A1 at upper left.

entries.caption: DM placements, columns A-AH
rows: In hoard; reacts to robbery or intrusion

entries: Nine monster pieces: Hydra 3×3; Bulette, two Displacer Beasts, Gelatinous Cube, two Owlbears and Young Red Dragon all 2×2; Spectator 1×1. Eddie Vale is an optional 1×1 civilian.

WEST connects at V12–V16 to EAST at A10–C14 through a 450-foot, roughly 30-foot-wide retail concourse. The hallway turns and has ordinary fire doors; the areas are not adjacent combat spaces. A character moving between them travels the distance normally.
WEST: shallow fountain water is difficult terrain without Swim Speed. Fountain rim, kiosks and storefront corners provide cover where they interrupt sightlines.

EAST: the Cube starts outside the west-kitchen doorway at M19–N20; Owlbear O1 remains behind a kitchen shutter at G19–H20. The dragon occupies Coronet's showroom at Z4–AA5, with a broken south frontage AB8–AD8 opening into the food court. Kitchen shutters and cases can be opened or broken; the main dining area has a 35-foot ceiling and 15-foot balconies.

Storefront glass: AC 13, 10 HP per 5-foot panel. Tables and jewelry cases can provide half cover. Bulette's crater is difficult terrain after emergence. Exterior sidewalks and parking are outside the planar-link boundary; the roof is inside.

entries.name: Thornwatch (0:00–0:05)
entries: The reeve hired the party to investigate violet lights, low humming, and odd reflections around the old stone waystation near Thornwatch.

READ ALOUD: The road to Thornwatch winds through dark pines. For three nights, locals have reported violet lights and a low hum near the abandoned waystation. Ahead, an old stone arch gleams faintly in the still air.
Faint scorch lines cross the arch; puddles sometimes reflect an unfamiliar ceiling. DC 13 Arcana reveals planar instability. The characters have time for introductions and a first action.

READ ALOUD: A deep note hums through the stones. Violet light fills the arch. Your reflections lag a heartbeat. The ground drops away, and the smell of pine becomes butter, sugar, and popcorn. Your boots strike red carpet before an enormous moving picture.
The pulse draws the nearby party through to the West cinema together, carrying their gear and magical abilities.

entries.name: The Cinema
entries: READ ALOUD: Rows of padded chairs face a wall-sized moving image. A child points at your weapons and asks, 'Are you in the movie?' A crash shakes the building; screams follow from the concourse.

Mel Ruiz, a cinema usher, is pinned under a fallen curtain bar (DC 13 Athletics, two people lifting, or suitable magic). Mel saw Bombeldo install the projector and heard a many-headed creature outside.

The crystal projector is in booth C3–E4, aimed at the screen. Its red STOP lever stops the motor but not the violet beam while any monster link remains. Nine strands glow within the crystal; DC 13 Arcana explains the feedback. The screen cannot yet carry anyone home.

entries.name: Encounter 1: Hydra
entries: READ ALOUD: The fountain cracks. Five scaled necks rise over the rim, throwing water across the walkway as shoppers flee toward the exits.

WEST L13–N15: one Huge Hydra (184 HP), fountain I12–O18. Shallow water is difficult terrain without Swim Speed; the low rim provides cover where relevant. The Hydra attacks armed threats, leaves the water when pursuing prey, and can smash storefront glass.

Use its 2024 head-severing, fire-suppression and attack abilities. When it falls, a violet arc discharges and one projector strand goes dark. Dana Torres is directing the evacuation from security office P3–U9.

entries.name: Dana Torres and the Concourse
entries: Dana Torres manages mall security in WEST. Her cameras recorded a violet blast from the cinema booth, creatures appearing across the building, and a red reptilian shape entering Coronet Jewelers in EAST. She cannot explain the magic.

Dana knows Bombeldo installed the projector for a Dungeoneer-sponsored screening and fled toward his shop in EAST. She has a service-pass key, camera access and evacuation routes. The east food court lies beyond the 450-foot retail concourse. Fire doors break sightlines and dampen the noise from the fountain.

entries.name: Encounter 2: Food-Court Menagerie
entries: READ ALOUD: Six-legged black panthers flicker between abandoned tables. A floating eye surveys the room from above, while a nearly transparent wall of jelly slides out of the kitchen. Cracks spread across the tiled floor.

EAST round 1: Spectator M10, 15 feet up; Displacer Beasts N12–O13 and U10–V11; Gelatinous Cube M19–N20, outside the kitchen doorway. At the start of round 2 the Bulette breaks through at Q17–R18, rolls initiative, and acts on its count.

The Spectator fights at range with eye rays, the Displacers stalk separate targets, the Cube Engulfs creatures in its path, and the Bulette attacks active threats near its emergence point. Tables give cover where they block sight. The Bulette leaves difficult terrain at the crater.

Owlbear O1 is behind the west kitchen shutter at G19–H20; Owlbear O2 is behind the east service shutter at AC19–AD20. Opening a shutter brings its resident into contact with the party. The Cube is on the dining side of the west-kitchen doorway, not in O1's room.
When this fight subsides, kitchen shutters rattle, Eddie Vale starts watching Coronet's broken displays, and the dragon remains within the jeweler.

entries.name: East Mall Between Battles
entries: The dragon is inside Coronet Jewelers at Z4–AA5. Its hoard consists of watches, necklaces, stones and gold. Eddie Vale, a civilian opportunist, waits near AB10, considering a theft. Bombeldo is frightened and hiding in The Dungeoneer; he knows where he installed the machine, not its planar mechanics.
The party may rest in a secured service corridor. A short rest lasts one in-world hour; the local event clock advances during that time.

entries.caption: Eddie, Owlbears, Dragon: two time scales
rows: Owlbear round 1: O1 and O2 emerge; Eddie enters Coronet and grabs a tray if unopposed.
+2–8 minutes: Owlbears emerge and forage; +5 minutes: Eddie approaches Coronet.
Owlbear round 2: Eddie runs out with the tray; dragon pursues if treasure was taken.
+10 minutes: Eddie takes the tray. +11 minutes: dragon follows into food court.
Interception, theft prevention, early dragon contact, or flight changes subsequent events.
+60 minutes: Eddie is pinned alive under a kiosk; dragon guards spilled jewelry in the food court; both Owlbears roam separately.

entries.name: Encounter 3: Owlbears and Dragon
entries: EAST: Owlbear O1 G19–H20 and O2 AC19–AD20 emerge from separate food-service areas. Neither obeys the dragon. Eddie starts near AB10 and enters Coronet during their disturbance.

READ ALOUD (if Eddie succeeds): A man runs from the shattered jewelry storefront clutching a velvet tray of watches. From the darkness behind him a voice bellows, 'THIEF!' A red dragon crashes through the opening and follows the glittering loot into the food court.

Young Red Dragon: 178 HP, Fire immunity, DC 17 Dexterity, 16d6 Fire breath in a 30-foot cone. Dragon starts Z4–AA5 inside jewelers, then exits through broken glass at AB8–AD8. Roll its initiative when it joins and use its normal turn. Two Owlbears: 59 HP each.

The dragon demands its treasure back and treats nearby armed strangers as potential thieves. It can fly in the 35-foot atrium. A stolen tray, an intruder in Coronet, or another threat to its hoard can provoke it; an intercepted Eddie does not automatically draw it out.
If the group returns after an hour's rest, start with Eddie pinned alive beneath a kiosk, the dragon occupying the food court with the spilled jewelry, and both Owlbears still foraging.

entries.name: The Projector and the Return
entries: Bombeldo's projector remains in WEST cinema booth C3–E4. Its motor can be stopped or unplugged, but its crystal beam persists as long as any of the nine monster links remain inside the building. It cannot banish or harm the monsters.

entries.caption: Crystal feedback
rows: Living linked monster remains inside mall or on roof
One strand glows; STOP halts motor only. Screen remains unstable.
Linked monster dies, leaves exterior building, or moves off-plane
Its strand goes dark. Off-plane disappearance is temporary if the creature later returns.
Final strand goes dark and STOP is already selected
Screen opens to Thornwatch for 60 seconds immediately.
Final strand goes dark while projector is running
Pull STOP to open the same 60-second doorway.
Cycle RUN then STOP again for another window.
Controlled return route fails. Other planar travel remains possible.

entries: RETURN READ ALOUD: The screen flickers behind you. A moment later the air smells of pine again, and the Thornwatch arch stands beside the road. Its violet marks fade to ordinary gray stone.

entries.caption: State changes
rows: Investigate or stop the projector first
Motor stops, crystal remains lit; nine strands lead toward linked creatures.
Turn or carry the crystal to follow the directional strand; no skill check to observe it.
They occupy their established rooms. Existing monsters aren't replaced later.
He never steals; dragon stays with its hoard unless otherwise threatened.
Use the two-scale event clock; surviving monsters retain their links.
Its link ends beyond exterior walls; it remains loose on Earth.
Honor actual distances, ranges and creature movement through the 450-foot concourse.
No controlled screen portal; repair or independent planar travel would be needed.
